storage_policy.description: vSphere Storage Policy (SPBM) name applied to the VM home and disks (optional). The datastore default policy is used when omitted. The policy must already exist in vCenter.

template.description: VM template name to clone from

library_item.description: OVF item name in the content library

firmware.description: Boot firmware for the VM. Talos OVAs from factory.talos.dev import as bios.

folder.description: VM folder path (optional, defaults to datacenter VM folder)

cluster_folder.description: Place VMs in a subfolder named after the cluster (best-effort, derived from the machine set name), created automatically under the folder above (or the datacenter VM folder)

ca_cert.description: PEM-encoded CA certificate(s) to trust on the machine. Provide the full certificate block including BEGIN/END lines. Multiple certificates can be concatenated.

tags.description: vCenter tags to attach to the VM (optional). Each entry is a tag name, or "category/name" when the tag name exists in multiple categories. Tags must already exist in vCenter.

pci_devices.description: PCI devices to pass through to the VM

label.description: hardware label of the host PCI device

extra_config.description: vSphere Advanced Parameters to set on the VM

value.description: parameter value as vCenter stores it, e.g. "TRUE"
